$comment: SPDX license expressions for every build/target dependency that can appear in vcpkg_installed (the root manifest closure plus each isolated STEP manifest). SEC-19/T19 requires this table to cover every installed target-architecture package or packaging fails. Review the upstream LICENSE/NOTICE before adding or changing an entry; host-only build tools (vcpkg-cmake, vcpkg-cmake-config) are excluded automatically because they are installed for x64-windows, not the target triplet.
